questions.stem: 在西方，上大學前先花一年旅行或擔任志工，一直被視為培養獨立性的寶貴機會。
questions.answer: In the West, spending a year traveling or volunteering before college has long been regarded as a precious opportunity to develop independence.
accepted_answers: In Western countries, taking a year off to travel or volunteer before college has always been seen as a valuable chance to become independent.
In the West, spending one year traveling or doing volunteer work before entering university has long been considered a precious opportunity to build independence.

patterns: 完成式被動（has long been p.p.）

questions.stem: 如今這種做法逐漸被台灣家長接受，讓孩子有更多時間探索自己的興趣與潛能。
questions.answer: This practice is now gradually being accepted by Taiwanese parents, giving their children more time to explore their interests and potential.
accepted_answers: Today, this practice is slowly being accepted by parents in Taiwan, allowing their children more time to explore their own interests and potential.
Nowadays, this idea is gradually being accepted by Taiwanese parents, giving kids more time to discover their interests and potential.

1.explanation_zh: 「上大學前先花一年旅行或擔任志工」是一整個動作當主詞，用動名詞片語 spending a year traveling or volunteering before college（spend + 時間 + V-ing），動名詞主詞視為單數。「一直被視為」用完成式被動 has long been regarded as／has always been seen as。「培養獨立性的寶貴機會」是 a precious opportunity to develop independence。
evidence: 上大學前先花一年旅行或擔任志工
1.strategy_zh: 動作當主詞 → V-ing …（單數）；「一直被視為」→ has long been regarded as。
hints: 切成四段：在西方／上大學前先花一年旅行或擔任志工／一直被視為／培養獨立性的寶貴機會
標的詞彙：the West（西方）、travel（旅行）、volunteer（擔任志工）、college（大學）、precious（寶貴的）、opportunity（機會）、independence（獨立）
句型框架：In the West, V-ing … + has long been regarded as + a + adj. + N + to V …

2.explanation_zh: 做法是「被」家長接受，而且正在逐漸發生，用被動進行式 is gradually being accepted by Taiwanese parents（也可用 has gradually been accepted）。「讓孩子有更多時間…」是前面整件事帶來的結果，用句尾分詞 , giving their children more time to …（give + 人 + 時間）。「探索自己的興趣與潛能」用 explore their interests and potential（「自己的」是 their (own)）。
2.strategy_zh: 「逐漸被…」正在發生 → is gradually being p.p.；「…，讓…」表結果 → , giving + 人 + N。
hints: 切成四段：如今這種做法／逐漸被台灣家長接受／讓孩子有更多時間／探索自己的興趣與潛能
標的詞彙：practice（做法）、gradually（逐漸地）、accept（接受）、parent（家長）、explore（探索）、interest（興趣）、potential（潛能）
句型框架：S + is gradually being p.p. + by …, giving + 人 + more time + to + V …

references: In the West, spending a year traveling or volunteering before college has long been regarded as a precious opportunity to develop independence.
In Western countries, taking a year off to travel or volunteer before college has always been seen as a valuable chance to become independent.
In the West, spending one year traveling or doing volunteer work before entering university has long been considered a precious opportunity to build independence.

patterns.label_zh: 完成式被動（一直被視為）
patterns.frame: S + has long been + p.p. + as …

patterns.label_zh: 動名詞片語當主詞（動詞用單數）
patterns.zh_trigger: 上大學前先花一年旅行或擔任志工

common_errors.explanation_zh: 指歐美文化的「西方」用 the West（大寫、加 the）。

parts.zh: 上大學前先花一年旅行或擔任志工
accepted: spending a year traveling or volunteering before college
taking a year off to travel or volunteer before college
spending one year traveling or doing volunteer work before entering university

common_errors.wrong: spend a year traveling or volunteering before college
common_errors.right: spending a year traveling or volunteering before college
common_errors.explanation_zh: 動作當主詞要用動名詞 spending（或 To spend），原形動詞不能當主詞。

common_errors.wrong: spending a year to travel or volunteering
common_errors.right: spending a year traveling or volunteering
common_errors.explanation_zh: spend + 時間 + V-ing；or 前後也要對稱（traveling or volunteering）。
動名詞片語當主詞視為單數，助動詞用 has。
「被視為」是被動，完成式被動要有 been。

parts.zh: 培養獨立性的寶貴機會
accepted: a precious opportunity to develop independence
a valuable chance to become independent
a precious opportunity to build independence

common_errors.wrong: a precious opportunity to develop independent
common_errors.right: a precious opportunity to develop independence
common_errors.explanation_zh: develop 後面接名詞 independence；independent 是形容詞（become independent）。
「寶貴的」用形容詞 precious／valuable；treasure 是名詞或動詞。

traps.literal_error: … has long been regarded as a precious opportunity to cultivate independent.
traps.explanation_zh: 「獨立性」是名詞 independence；develop／build 後面要接名詞，形容詞 independent 只能接在 become 後面。

traps.zh: 上大學前先花一年旅行或擔任志工
traps.literal_error: In the West, spend a year traveling or volunteering before college has long been regarded as …
traps.explanation_zh: 中文直接拿動作當主詞，英文要改成動名詞 spending …（單數，配 has）。

bonus.text: Taking a gap year to travel or volunteer before college has long been hailed in the West as an invaluable chance to grow more independent.
bonus.explanation_zh: gap year（空檔年）、be hailed as（被譽為）、invaluable（極為寶貴的，不是「沒價值」）、grow more independent 都更道地。

1.restructuring_zh: 中文主詞「上大學前先花一年…」是動作，英文要轉成動名詞 spending …；「上大學前」放在動名詞片語尾 before college；「培養獨立性的寶貴機會」把修飾語改成後位不定詞 a precious opportunity to develop independence。

references: This practice is now gradually being accepted by Taiwanese parents, giving their children more time to explore their interests and potential.
Today, this practice is slowly being accepted by parents in Taiwan, allowing their children more time to explore their own interests and potential.
Nowadays, this idea is gradually being accepted by Taiwanese parents, giving kids more time to discover their interests and potential.

patterns.label_zh: 句尾分詞片語表結果（讓…）
patterns.frame: S + V …, giving + 人 + more time + to V …

patterns.label_zh: 被動語態（進行式被動 is being p.p.）

common_errors.wrong: This way of doing is now
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「做法」指行之有年的作法，用 practice（或 idea、trend）；way of doing 後面少了受詞，不完整。

accepted: gradually being accepted by Taiwanese parents
slowly being accepted by parents in Taiwan
gradually been accepted by Taiwanese parents

common_errors.right: gradually being accepted by Taiwanese parents
common_errors.explanation_zh: 做法是「被」接受，要用被動 be (being) accepted。

common_errors.wrong: gradually being accepted from Taiwanese parents
common_errors.right: gradually being accepted by Taiwanese parents
common_errors.explanation_zh: 被動語態的動作者用 by 帶出。

common_errors.wrong: let their children have more time
common_errors.explanation_zh: 逗號後直接接 let 會變成第二個動詞沒有連接；表結果用分詞 giving／allowing，或改成 , which lets …。
句尾表結果的部分用現在分詞 giving，不用另一個主要動詞 gives。

parts.zh: 探索自己的興趣與潛能
accepted: to explore their interests and potential
to explore their own interests and potential
to discover their interests and potential

common_errors.wrong: to explore their interesting and potential
common_errors.right: to explore their interests and potential
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「興趣」是名詞 interests；interesting 是形容詞「有趣的」。
「自己的」用所有格 their (own)，不是 themselves。

traps.literal_error: … giving their children more time to explore their interesting and potential ability.
traps.explanation_zh: 「興趣」「潛能」都是名詞：interests and potential；interesting 是形容詞，詞性不對。

traps.literal_error: Now this practice is gradually being accepted by Taiwanese parents, let their children have more time …
traps.explanation_zh: 中文後半句沒有主詞，英文不能在逗號後直接接 let；用句尾分詞 giving their children more time …（或 , which gives …）。

bonus.text: Now that Taiwanese parents are gradually warming to the idea, more and more teenagers are being given the time to explore their interests and potential.
bonus.explanation_zh: warm to（逐漸接受）、be given the time to …（被給予時間），用 now that 帶出因果，句子更流暢。

2.restructuring_zh: 「讓孩子有更多時間…」不另起一句，用句尾分詞 giving their children more time to …，邏輯主詞是前面「這種做法被接受」這件事；「探索自己的興趣與潛能」用不定詞 to explore … 修飾 time。

warnings: annotations.rubric.items.1.patterns[0]: gp-perfect-passive 通常對應句構 PERF（目前 code=PASS）

1.translation: In the West, spending a year traveling or volunteering before going to college has long been regarded as a valuable opportunity to develop independence.
1.explanation_zh: 「上大學前先花一年旅行或擔任志工」整件事當主詞，用動名詞片語 spending a year V-ing；「一直被視為」用現在完成式被動 has long been regarded as；「培養獨立性」譯 develop independence，以不定詞修飾 opportunity。

2.translation: Nowadays, this practice has gradually been accepted by Taiwanese parents, giving their children more time to explore their own interests and potential.
2.explanation_zh: 「逐漸被台灣家長接受」用現在完成式被動；「讓孩子有更多時間……」是接受這個做法帶來的結果，用句尾分詞 giving their children more time to...；「潛能」譯 potential（不可數）。

issues_zh: 建議（不影響判定）：第 2 部分可補「before going to college」，第 4 部分可補「a valuable opportunity to develop independence」；參考譯文 0、2 的 precious opportunity 可接受，但 valuable opportunity 搭配更常見，首選譯文可考慮改用 valuable。

1.translation: In the West, spending a year traveling or volunteering before entering college has long been regarded as a valuable opportunity to develop independence.
1.explanation_zh: 「上大學前先花一年旅行或擔任志工」整段當動名詞片語做主詞；「一直被視為」用現在完成式被動 has long been regarded as；「培養獨立性」用 develop independence。

2.translation: Today, this practice is gradually being accepted by parents in Taiwan, which gives their children more time to explore their own interests and potential.
2.explanation_zh: 「逐漸被……接受」用現在進行式被動 is gradually being accepted；「讓孩子有更多時間探索」用 which gives + 間接受詞 + 直接受詞 + to 不定詞；「興趣與潛能」是 interests and potential。

issues_zh: 我的譯文是 …, which gives their children more time to explore …（非限定關係子句），自然又正確；但第 3 部分「讓孩子有更多時間」的 accepted 只收 giving／allowing 的分詞片語，中文沒有強制分詞構句，標的句型 PART 沒有被引出。建議 accepted 補上 which gives／which allows，或移除 PART 標的。
